subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in auto-mention policy that prepends the original guild reply author to native replies when the model did not mention them?
rationale: The source shows no existing supported option, and the request changes notification behavior plus Discord config surface rather than repairing a current documented bug contract.

options.title: Approve opt-in Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID-aware prefixing, broadcast safety, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

options.title: Decline extra notification policy
options.body: Keep the existing `replyToMode` and `mentionAliases` model and close this as not planned if visible mentions should remain agent-authored.

options.title: Defer pending live evidence
options.body: Require a live multi-agent Discord repro and notification comparison before deciding whether the config surface is worth adding.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID-aware prefixing, broadcast safety, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied to current Discord mention/schema history and the outbound mention-alias feature that any implementation would need to preserve.
